name: Logic and Brainteasers
description: Crack logic puzzles with invariants, careful search and backward induction, at interview pace.

lessonObjectives.l1-what-stays-the-same: Solve a puzzle by finding a quantity that no move can change.
lessonObjectives.l2-colouring-boards: Prove a tiling or a route impossible by colouring the board.
lessonObjectives.l3-pigeonhole: Force a coincidence by counting boxes and objects.
lessonObjectives.l4-weighing-coins: Find a fake coin in the fewest weighings by splitting into three groups.
lessonObjectives.l5-ropes-and-jugs: Measure a time or a volume with tools built to measure something else.
lessonObjectives.l6-back-from-the-end: Solve pirate and voting puzzles by backward induction from the smallest case.
lessonObjectives.l7-hat-strategies: Design a team strategy for hat-colour puzzles using parity.
lessonObjectives.l8-prisoners-and-boxes: Use the cycle-following strategy and find its chance of success.
lessonObjectives.l9-egg-drop: Minimise the worst case of a two-egg search with triangle numbers, then by dynamic programming.
lessonObjectives.l10-what-they-know: Reason about common knowledge in islander and muddy-children puzzles by induction.
lessonObjectives.l11-crossings-and-schedules: Find the fastest bridge or river crossing and prove that nothing beats it.
lessonObjectives.l12-clocks-and-trains: Solve clock-angle and meeting problems in one line of algebra.
lessonObjectives.l13-digits-and-remainders: Find last digits and test divisibility with modular arithmetic.
lessonObjectives.l14-sums-in-one-line: Sum series and counts fast by pairing, telescoping and counting twice.
lessonObjectives.l15-numbers-to-know: Estimate √2, e, ln 2, π² and powers of 2 to two figures, and use the rule of 72.
lessonObjectives.l16-mixed-set: Solve an unlabelled set of brainteasers in interview order at a stated pace.
